title: Computational Thinking
standfirst: How to break a problem into steps a computer can follow — the ideas behind programming, taught before any language.
instructor: Prof. Madhavan Mukund & Prof. G Venkatesh

description_paragraphs: Students will be introduced to key programming concepts through illustrative examples, most of which are worked out manually. This step-by-step approach enables close examination and deeper understanding of the concepts discussed.
faculty: Prof. Madhavan Mukund, Director, Chennai Mathematical Institute
Prof. G Venkatesh, Director, School of Technology, Dhirubhai Ambani University

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Introduction to datasets, variables, filtering and iteration; flowcharts; data types and data integrity.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Iterative problem solving; conditional logic, aggregation (max, counts), and introduction to pseudocode.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Tabular data representation; multi-step analysis, hypothesis testing, and modular programming with procedures.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Nested iterations and computational complexity; optimization techniques like binning; real-world text and data matching problems.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Introduction to collections; list data structures and basic operations.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Advanced list operations; sorting, ordered data, and data-driven hypothesis testing.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Dictionaries and key-value data structures; applications in real-world data relationships.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Advanced dictionary operations; combining lists and dictionaries; side effects and structured data processing.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Graph data structures; representation, relationships, and real-world network modeling.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Graph representations and traversal strategies; adjacency structures and path-finding approaches.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Recursion and depth-first search; algorithm design using recursive procedures.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Comprehensive problem solving and revision across programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
